meta.bootstrap: 300 resamples of whole days (30 dev days; days are the unit, so CIs treat days as exchangeable and ignore that they come from one building)
meta.sealed_guard: only ERTU_* and Inc_Eco_* files are opened (asserted by prefix); OA_damper*/SA_temp_bias* never touched
meta.units: temperature in K (deltas; degF*5/9), power/flow as relative noise (fraction of level) and additive floor as fraction of series max

missingness.structural_definition: NaN in RTU_SA_TEMP/RTU_RA_TEMP/RTU_SA_FLOW/VAV_RM_SAT_* while RTU_SA_FAN_WATT<=100 W (fan off / setback)
missingness.random_definition: any other NaN (any channel while fan on, or any NaN in a channel that is never structurally NaN)

stale.method: fraction of valid samples inside runs of >=L exactly-identical consecutive values, on 22 continuous temp/flow channels, minus a Bernoulli(channel repeat prob) null simulated per day

sampling.note: timestamps are exact minute stamps; no jitter below 1 min is observable. Whole days are missing between recorded days (files are sparse samples of days).

temp.method: trimmed-RMS of 2nd differences of 1-min data (var d2 = 6 sigma^2), median of per-day sigmas; quantisation-limited (quantum 0.0056 K): true white noise may be smaller

value.method: same, on VAV/RTU discharge-air sensors while fan on; includes real turbulence/cycling so an upper bound on sensor noise

flow.method: same, relative to level, RTU_SA_FLOW only (no per-box flow exists) - transferred to VAV/loop flow by assumption

power.method: same, relative to level (>150 W VAV reheat, >500 W RTU) on quiet samples

power_abs_frac.method: noise sd of VAV reheat at standby (<30 W) divided by channel max; quantum-limited (2.77 W quantum)

temp.method: sd of 1-min samples about the within-hour straight line; hours with 60 valid samples; RMS over hours and sensors
smallest non-zero step of 0.01 degF on Spring/Summer/Winter files (all samples on the grid); Fall file is unquantised/resampled

flow.method: 1 cfm step / median p95 flow (Spring-Winter; Fall 0.5 cfm)

power.method: 2.77 W step / median per-channel VAV max power

frac.method: random NaN samples (fan-on or non-fan channels) / all channel-samples on 1-min data; ~1 event per 6e4 samples

run_mean_min.method: 83 events, nearly all 1 min, one 55-min run

field_prior_frac.method: log-uniform prior for a field BAS/trend export; the lab logger has essentially no dropouts so the field rate is NOT identified by this data

frac.method: fraction of valid fan-on samples inside exact-repeat runs >= 60 identical values (none observed; max run 7 min)

rule_of_three_upper_95.method: rule-of-three upper bound on per-sample rate over the stale-checked channels

field_prior_frac.method: frozen-sensor/flatline prior; none observed in lab data

value.method: sd across 10 VAV SAT sensors of their mean deviation from the box median, unheated boxes (<30 W), fan on; includes real duct-location gradients so an upper-ish bound

temp.method: sd across 10 rooms of mean deviation from the room median; DOMINATED by real zone differences (solar/orientation), so an UPPER bound on calibration spread

random_walk_sd.method: rms change of per-sensor VAV-SAT offset between chronologically-adjacent season files (63-265 days apart), scaled by sqrt(gap/90); rough proxy, not drift

linear_sd.method: assumed half of the random-walk proxy; long-term linear drift is not identifiable from 2-day windows

room_upper.method: same construction on room temps (includes real load/season changes)

jitter_min.method: raw stamps are exact minutes (0 non-zero seconds) so sub-minute jitter is unobservable; range is a prior for a trend-log export

lag_min.method: inter-channel lag not identifiable (channels share a logger clock)

missing_minutes_within_days.method: all 30 days have exactly 1440 consecutive 1-min stamps, no duplicates

not_estimable: flow-sensor noise for individual VAV boxes and water loops (only RTU_SA_FLOW exists)
hour-scale dropouts / stale runs in field BAS exports
true calibration offsets separate from real spatial temperature gradients
